title: What VPSF means
question: What is Value Per Square Foot?
body: VPSF is a home-performance score out of 1,000, based on the information available for one home.

sections.heading: What it covers
sections.text: Seven pillars span energy, water, health, resilience, materials, financial risk, and community and mobility.

sections.heading: What it does not measure
sections.text: It is not a dollar-per-square-foot appraisal, certification, resale estimate, or promise of future value.

title: How the calculator works
question: How does the VPSF calculator work?
body: Enter an address, choose an analysis level, then review the available home details.

sections.heading: Choose depth
sections.text: Basic uses available records. Superior supports a fuller review with documents, photos, and homeowner-confirmed details.

sections.heading: Confirm
sections.text: Correct facts, review supporting evidence, and generate your score. More detail can raise or lower it.

sections.heading: Explore
sections.text: My Scores opens results. Menu links to recommendations, learning, products, and sharing.

title: Finding relevant products
question: Where can I get more information on the best products to raise my home's VPSF score?
body: Recommended Products shows options linked to the home's improvement opportunities.

sections.heading: Explore
sections.text: Search by brand or product; filter by pillar or category.

sections.heading: Award library
sections.text: Explore Green Builder's 2024–2026 award winners with photos and sources. Awards do not imply Premiere Partner status.

sections.heading: Request information
sections.text: Request Specifications/Pricing sends inquiries to VPSF for review, not directly to manufacturers.

sections.heading: Check fit
sections.text: Products add no automatic points. Confirm suitability and installation requirements.

title: Correcting or adding home details
question: What if a home detail is missing or wrong?
body: On Review & Confirm, use Edit/Add Details to fix missing or incorrect facts.

sections.heading: Check systems
sections.text: Record known equipment type and age, including HVAC, water heating, roofing, ventilation, solar, and storage. Use All Home Specs for more.

sections.heading: Verify
sections.text: Confirm the address and support changes with permits, labels, invoices, photos, or inspections. Added details are saved for later visits.

title: Performance expectations
question: Do you guarantee performance increases?
body: No. VPSF estimates are not a guarantee of real-world performance or score gains.

sections.heading: Why results vary
sections.text: Product choice, design, installation, maintenance, and other construction details can affect performance.

sections.heading: Our basis
sections.text: The model draws on decades of building-science experience, not AI. Sound building science can improve a property; verify actual performance after improvements.

title: Address and public records
body: The address connects available property records and regional context.

sections.heading: Check
sections.text: Confirm address, unit, ZIP, and property details before scoring.

sections.heading: PermitStack
sections.text: Permit history is not a complete-record guarantee. A permit does not prove completed work, installed equipment, or equipment age.

sections.heading: Gaps
sections.text: Missing permits do not prove no work occurred; verify current systems.

sections.heading: Default address
sections.text: Opening or Restart uses the California demo address. Archived homes load only when you explicitly reopen them.

title: Documenting key systems
body: Key Systems records major features that affect home performance.

sections.heading: Include
sections.text: Heating and cooling, water heating, roof, ventilation, solar, and battery storage, with type, age, or capacity when known.

sections.heading: Unknowns
sections.text: Use All Home Specs for additional measures. Leave unknown details blank until you can verify them; missing information is not proof of an upgrade.

title: What counts as evidence
body: Documents and photos suggest details for your review.

sections.heading: Photo PROCESS
sections.text: Exact-address public photos are reviewed transiently and not saved. Remove unwanted results before PROCESS.

sections.heading: Your photos
sections.text: Added photos are sanitized, privately archived, and expire 365 days after authorized access. Capabilities are credentials, not share links.

sections.heading: Documents
sections.text: Upload files or public links, read documents, resolve conflicts, and apply reviewed details.

sections.heading: Privacy
sections.text: Homeowner photos take priority. Photo quantity never adds points. Selected images may use Mistral; original videos stay on your device.

title: Reading the VPSF score
body: The VPSF total adds seven pillar scores, with 1,000 points available in the current model.

sections.heading: Read the detail
sections.text: The overview shows the total and label. Pillar pages show strengths, missing evidence, and upgrade opportunities.

sections.heading: Avoid confusion
sections.text: A percentage of available points is not a market percentile. The report is not a certification, insurance quote, or savings guarantee.

title: The seven scoring pillars
body: Each pillar measures a different part of home performance and has its own point maximum.

sections.heading: Energy
sections.text: Efficiency, electrification, and energy exposure.

sections.heading: Water
sections.text: Conservation and water-damage risk.

sections.heading: Health
sections.text: Indoor conditions, including ventilation and moisture.

sections.heading: Resilience
sections.text: Hazards and the home's ability to withstand them.

sections.heading: Carbon & Materials
sections.text: Material impacts and documentation.

sections.heading: Financial Risk
sections.text: Ownership-cost exposure.

sections.heading: Community & Mobility
sections.text: Surrounding context and transportation.

sections.heading: Where to look
sections.text: Menu has general definitions; My Scores shows the assessed home's results.

title: How location affects the report
body: Location sets climate and hazard context for the report.

sections.heading: Sources
sections.text: When coordinates are available, public flood and wildfire layers may be used.

sections.heading: Limits
sections.text: These area-level signals can be missing or imprecise; they do not replace a site inspection. After correcting an address, review its risk context again.

sections.heading: Planning
sections.text: Let local hazards guide resilience upgrades.

title: Using recommendations
body: Recommendations target weaknesses in the current home record.

sections.heading: Explore
sections.text: Each includes a summary, Learn More for building science, and Product Options for relevant categories.

sections.heading: Use impact points
sections.text: Points are model estimates, not guaranteed gains or savings. Compare options with equipment, climate, budget, and documentation.

sections.heading: Recheck
sections.text: After work, update the saved home and score it again.

title: Learning the building science
body: Learn More explains why an upgrade matters and how it works.

sections.heading: Watch or read
sections.text: Some topics have a short video; written details remain available. Find topics from recommendations or Building Science Basics in Menu.

sections.heading: Apply
sections.text: Use the guide to question contractors, then verify product and installation fit for this home.

title: Finding Green Builder Insights
body: Pillar Insights collect Green Builder Media articles by pillar.

sections.heading: Browse
sections.text: Open them from Building Science Basics or Key Takeaway. Individual articles use a clean reader; collections show linked lists.

sections.heading: Use with care
sections.text: Articles offer background, not a project-specific design, inspection, or local code review.

title: Planning a path to 700
body: Path to 700 organizes upgrades toward the High Performance threshold.

sections.heading: Prioritize
sections.text: Start with missing or weak systems, then choose work suited to the home's climate and condition.

sections.heading: Check progress
sections.text: Keep installation and performance proof, update the saved home, and recalculate. Displayed points are estimates, not promises.

title: Understanding future cost exposure
body: Future Cost Exposure compares ownership risks such as aging systems, utilities, maintenance, and insurance.

sections.heading: Use it
sections.text: Check equipment condition, local prices, and climate hazards before deciding what to replace.

sections.heading: Limits
sections.text: It is not a personal quote or bill forecast. VPSF points are separate from real-world dollars.

title: Using the VPSF Report Card
body: The Report Card summarizes the address, total, performance label, and seven pillar scores.

sections.heading: Before sharing
sections.text: Check for missing or incorrect details.

sections.heading: Export
sections.text: Download the single-page PDF or use Share Report. It is not a certified label, appraisal, market percentile, or savings guarantee.

title: Sharing your score
body: Share Your Score presents a home's strengths, improvement opportunities, and supporting information.

sections.heading: Review first
sections.text: Check the address, photos, score, and claims. Keep system and upgrade records current.

sections.heading: Portable summary
sections.text: Use the VPSF Report Card for a downloadable score summary.

title: Data, privacy, and limits
body: VPSF combines your entries with available property data and saves reviewed details.

sections.heading: Uploads
sections.text: Public photos are processed transiently and not saved. Selected evidence may use Mistral.

sections.heading: Private photo storage
sections.text: Added photos are sanitized, privately archived, and expire 365 days after authorized access. Capabilities are credentials, not share links.

sections.heading: Your choice
sections.text: Manufacturer inquiries require your submission. Administrator-controlled sharing is separate from scoring.

sections.heading: Limits
sections.text: Public records can be incomplete. Scores do not replace inspections, audits, underwriting, or appraisals.

title: Basic and Superior
body: Analysis labels describe how much information you review, not the homeâ€™s performance rating.

sections.heading: Basic
sections.text: Basic starts with available property records and regional context; review them before generating an analysis.

sections.heading: Superior
sections.text: Superior supports fuller details, documents, and a guided photo walk.

sections.heading: Points
sections.text: Choosing Superior adds no points. Completeness is separate from performance; better evidence can raise or lower scores.

title: How certification affects points
body: Certification requirements can fill missing features when an exact, published mapping applies.

sections.heading: Feature points
sections.text: Eligible features receive ordinary VPSF points once, not a blanket certification bonus. Duplicate certificates add no extra points.

sections.heading: Limits
sections.text: The program name alone is insufficient. Edition, level, property scope, and exceptions must match; not every catalog program has automatic mappings.

sections.heading: Your control
sections.text: Review the supported features. An explicit correction wins over a certification assumption.

question: How does a home certification affect my VPSF score?

title: Adding and reviewing a certification
body: Open the optional Certifications section in home details.

sections.heading: Add
sections.text: Select Add certification, then the program, exact edition, and level. Unknown editions remain recognition only.

sections.heading: Review
sections.text: Check Filled from certification. Use Edit to replace an assumption with your answer; resolve any review notices before scoring.

sections.heading: Keep current
sections.text: Remove incorrect claims. Changing the property address clears claims; add only certificates for the new property.

title: Reviewing certification evidence
body: Use the certificate and supporting project records to identify applicable requirements.

sections.heading: Match
sections.text: Check the exact edition, level, address and unit, scope, and exceptions. A date or scanned label alone does not verify eligibility or authenticity.

sections.heading: LEED and NGBS
sections.text: Optional credits need the actual project scorecard; certification level alone does not establish selected features.

sections.heading: Review
sections.text: Only supported, published requirements fill unknown features. Unmapped facts remain report information without invented points.

title: Certification program catalog
body: Eight program groups provide reference coverage, not automatic scoring for every program or edition.

sections.heading: WaterSense
sections.text: Labeled homes.

sections.heading: ENERGY STAR
sections.text: Residential homes; obtain the equipment report.

sections.heading: Indoor AirPlus
sections.text: Certified and Gold differ.

sections.heading: LEED
sections.text: Residential prerequisites and optional credits.

sections.heading: NGBS Green
sections.text: Mandatory requirements and optional credits.

sections.heading: Phius / Passive House
sections.text: Phius and Passive House Institute use separate rules.

sections.heading: FORTIFIED
sections.text: Check level, edition, and peril.

sections.heading: Wildfire Prepared Home
sections.text: Base and Plus differ.

title: Limited automatic feature mappings
body: Automatic discovery requires a matching published rule; catalog inclusion alone does not fill features.

sections.heading: WaterSense v2
sections.text: Eligible homes can supply missing labeled toilets, bathroom sink faucets, and showerheads. No fixture counts, dishwasher, irrigation, or shutoff are implied.

sections.heading: Indoor AirPlus v2 Gold
sections.text: Can support balanced ventilation; Certified tier alone cannot. Balanced does not establish an ERV.

sections.heading: Other programs
sections.text: Obtain project evidence; do not assume equipment, materials, or optional credits from a label.

title: Correcting certification assumptions
body: Your explicit correction wins; certification-derived features fill only genuinely missing information.

sections.heading: Known answers
sections.text: Explicit No/None and current specific evidence take priority. Resolve conflicting evidence rather than choosing the higher score.

sections.heading: Replaced equipment
sections.text: Record replaced systems; an old certificate describes installation at certification and does not establish current equipment age.

sections.heading: Remove or correct
sections.text: On reassessment, removing a certificate removes its derived assumptions. Your explicit answers survive.

title: What a certification cannot establish
body: Program requirements have specific limits; a generic label does not describe every installed feature.

sections.heading: ENERGY STAR and Passive House
sections.text: Obtain rating, equipment, and test reports. Do not assume a HERS number, fuel, solar, window product, or exact test measurement.

sections.heading: FORTIFIED
sections.text: Roof, Silver, and Gold differ by edition and peril. Roof designation does not establish noncombustible siding.

sections.heading: Wildfire Prepared Home
sections.text: Check Base or Plus and edition. Class A roofing does not mean metal roofing.

title: Archive: saved evaluations and historical reports
body: My Scores → ARCHIVE automatically saves the last 50 completed evaluations in this browser.

sections.heading: View
sections.text: Original raw inputs, pillar scores, total, and model version stay unchanged.

sections.heading: Edit
sections.text: Edit details; generate a new score.

sections.heading: Remove
sections.text: Remove individual evaluations; clearing browser data clears Archive.

sections.heading: Keep/share
sections.text: Download PDF to keep/share records.

sections.heading: Products
sections.text: Product recommendations refresh from the current catalog.

sections.heading: Earlier searches
sections.text: Cannot recover searches unsaved before this feature.

title: Manufacturer inquiries and consent
body: Product inquiries are submitted by you; scoring does not automatically contact manufacturers.

sections.heading: Request
sections.text: Choose a product and review your contact details, project needs, and consent before submitting an inquiry.

sections.heading: Administrator control
sections.text: An administrator reviews inquiries and controls sharing. They are not automatically sent to manufacturers.

sections.heading: Private evidence
sections.text: Documents and private certificate evidence are not automatically sent with inquiries. A product listing alone adds no points.
